phases.name: prep
phases.description: DF3.6b Leg B (attachment): marker phase before the run_start solicitation. NO residentRssBytes field is declared on this manifest, DELIBERATELY: the in-box front door (scripts/pipeline-run.ts, inBoxFrontDoor) supplies the bound from loadResidentBounds — the manifest value or the shipped PROVISIONAL_RESIDENT_RSS_BYTES default — so this leg arms the resident under the PRODUCTION default exactly as a real run would, and its first solicitation's memory.peak read is the pi baseline measurement the story DoD requires (zero marginal spend). Two real pi solicitations (run_start, run_end) ride one key.

phases.name: settle
phases.description: DF3.6b Leg B (attachment): marker phase after the second solicitation. A healthy leg never trips the bound, so both phases and gates run on the deterministic path with the resident armed the whole way — attachment, not crossing, is what this leg proves.
